cur:objects-schnuetgen-koimesis-ivory.summary: The Virgin lies in death on a draped bier while the apostles crowd around in mourning. At the centre, behind the bier, Christ stands looking down, holding his Mother's soul as a small swaddled figure; two angels swoop down from above with veiled hands to receive it. Carved in deep, crisp relief, the plaque expresses the Byzantine faith that death for Christ's Mother was a falling asleep into his arms.
facts: Byzantine ivories of the Dormition reached the West early; Ottonian patrons valued them highly and often reused them on book covers (type).
